envelope.description: Capture the real-world config regression fixture and the pre-change defaults literal

body.title: Capture the real-world config regression fixture and the pre-change defaults literal
body.summary: Take a verbatim copy of an actual ~/.insrc/config.json into src/config/__tests__/fixtures/ (redacting only secrets, preserving structure) that carries populated values in all three catalog-unenumerable namespaces — models.analyze.roleTiers.<roleId>, models.analyze.byRepo.<absPath>.*, models.agents — plus at least one key absent from the current 41-row CONFIG_CATALOG and one key whose value is type-invalid for its catalog row. Keep the untouched original alongside it as the pre-change baseline so before/after can be diffed byte-for-byte. This must be a captured document, not hand-authored: no s1 exploration touched those namespaces' on-disk shape, and blind preservation is the acceptance requirement with the least evidence behind it — so commit a provenance note (README or JSON header comment file) recording that it was captured from a real ~/.insrc/config.json, the capture date, and exactly which values were redacted and how, with every redaction a structure-preserving substitution (same key set, same value types, same nesting depth as the original). Also capture, as a second fixture in the same directory, the hand-rolled defaults literal currently at src/daemon/index.ts:180-192 verbatim as JSON — t9 needs it as the pre-change baseline to prove first-boot equivalence, and it disappears from the source when t9 lands. No production code is touched by this task.
acceptanceChecks: A fixture file exists under src/config/__tests__/fixtures/ containing non-empty objects at models.analyze.roleTiers, models.analyze.byRepo (with at least one absolute-path key), and models.agents
The fixture contains at least one dot-path present in CONFIG_CATALOG whose value violates the row's declared type, and at least one CONFIG_CATALOG path that is absent entirely
An unmodified copy of the same document is committed as the before-baseline, and the two are byte-identical at capture time

A provenance note is committed alongside recording the real-config origin, the capture date, and the redaction list; each redaction is structure-preserving (same key set, value types and nesting depth as the captured original), stated explicitly so a reviewer can distinguish the fixture from a hand-authored guess
A second fixture holds the pre-change src/daemon/index.ts:180-192 defaults literal verbatim as JSON, with its key set matching the literal exactly
Both fixtures parse as valid JSON and contain no credential or token values

tests.name: captured config fixture — parses, carries non-empty models.analyze.roleTiers / models.analyze.byRepo (absolute-path key) / models.agents, one absent catalog path and one type-invalid catalog path
fixture baseline integrity — the before-baseline copy is byte-identical to the captured document and neither contains a credential or token value
captured defaults-literal fixture — key set matches the pre-change src/daemon/index.ts:180-192 literal exactly
